verdicts.reason: A: the hero photo is reduced to an unrecognisable scrap at far left, a stray yellow sliver clips the top-right edge, and the centred yellow headline block floats in empty white with no image. The original's key visual is effectively gone. B: keeps the headline block and a small but recognisable mother-and-baby photo on the right, which reads left to right. Still, the photo is a tiny thumbnail, most of the strip is dead white, the yellow frame motif is gone and the headline is small. It is weak but more faithful than A.
